_comment: Eastern Cape Department of Education Grade 10 Geography P2 (Mapwork), November 2018 provincial common examination.
Questions and marking-guideline answers extracted from the text layer of the official PDFs
(paper2.pdf, paper2_memo.pdf) and read against the rendered pages. Figures, maps,
graphs and photographs are described in [FIGURE: ...] brackets inside 'context'. memo_answer is
from the official marking guideline (English); mark allocations such as (2) are kept, one
accepted point per line. Column A/B items use the Grade 12 '[Y ... / Z ...]' style.
FORMAT: one 1½-hour paper answered in the question paper, 75 marks, all questions compulsory:
Question 1 multiple choice (15), Section B Question 2 mapwork calculations and techniques (20),
Question 3 map and photo application and interpretation (24), Question 4 GIS (16). It is based on
the 1 : 50 000 topographic map 3126DD QUEENSTOWN and the orthophoto map 3126DD 13 QUEENSTOWN, which
schools collected separately; the map sheets were not published with the paper, so map-read inputs
come from the memo's accepted values. Multiple-choice answers are the boxed letters in the marking
guideline. In 1.4 the question paper prints options A and B both as '3126 DD'.

questions.context: GENERAL INFORMATION ON QUEENSTOWN: Queenstown, now Komani, is a town in the middle of the Eastern Cape Province of South Africa, roughly halfway between the smaller towns of Cathcart and Sterkstroom. It is currently the commercial, administrative and educational centre of the surrounding farming district. Its former nickname, 'Rose Capital of South Africa', comes from the large gardens and open places for flowers, (especially roses), in and around the town. Coordinates: 31° 54' 0" S, 26° 53' 0" E. The area demarcated in RED on the topographic map represents the area covered by the orthophoto map. Glossary on the map: Landing strip - Vliegveld; Furrow - Voor; Caravan Park - Karavaanpark; Canal - Kanaal; Sewerage works - Rioolwerke; Golf Course - Gholfbaan; Excavation - Uitgrawing; Nature reserve - Natuurreservaat; Rifle Range - Skietbaan; Aerodrome - Vliegveld; Ravine - Kloof. | QUESTION 1: MULTIPLE-CHOICE QUESTIONS. The questions below are based on the 1 : 50 000 topographic map 3126DD QUEENSTOWN, as well as the orthophoto map of a part of the mapped area. Magnetic bearing = True bearing + Magnetic declination
= 52° + 27° 12'
= 79° 12'
